Desktop OS.reason: XSS in Twine 2 desktop enables script execution and local file operations via crafted story imports, directly impacting desktop application security.
Desktop OS.reason_en: XSS in Twine 2 desktop enables script execution and local file operations via crafted story imports, directly impacting desktop application security.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Twine 2桌面版存在XSS漏洞，可通过构造的故事导入实现脚本执行和本地文件操作，直接影响桌面应用程序的安全性。

Cloud Security.reason: Authentication bypass in ZITADEL Login V1 UI allows unauthenticated account takeover by trusting forged external identity fields without IdP callback verification.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Authentication bypass in ZITADEL Login V1 UI allows unauthenticated account takeover by trusting forged external identity fields without IdP callback verification.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: ZITADEL登录V1界面存在身份验证绕过漏洞，在未进行IdP回调验证的情况下信任伪造的外部身份字段，导致攻击者可实现未认证的账户接管。

Cloud Security.reason: ZITADEL links user accounts to external identity providers without verifying primary factors or permissions, enabling unauthenticated account hijacking.
Cloud Security.reason_en: ZITADEL links user accounts to external identity providers without verifying primary factors or permissions, enabling unauthenticated account hijacking.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: ZITADEL在关联用户账户与外部身份提供商时未验证主要验证因子或权限，从而导致未认证的账户劫持。

Cloud Security.reason: go-micro defaults to InsecureSkipVerify for TLS, exposing microservice communications to man-in-the-middle attacks and credential theft.
Cloud Security.reason_en: go-micro defaults to InsecureSkipVerify for TLS, exposing microservice communications to man-in-the-middle attacks and credential theft.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: go-micro默认对TLS启用InsecureSkipVerify配置，使微服务通信暴露于中间人攻击和凭证窃取风险之下。

Cloud Security.reason: AhsayCBS contains an OS command injection flaw in its replication receiver API, allowing remote attackers to execute arbitrary system commands.
Cloud Security.reason_en: AhsayCBS contains an OS command injection flaw in its replication receiver API, allowing remote attackers to execute arbitrary system commands.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: AhsayCBS的复制接收器API存在操作系统命令注入缺陷，允许远程攻击者执行任意系统命令。

Cloud Security.reason: Capgo allows password changes without current password confirmation, enabling session hijackers to permanently lock out legitimate users.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Capgo allows password changes without current password confirmation, enabling session hijackers to permanently lock out legitimate users.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Capgo允许在未确认当前密码的情况下更改密码，致使会话劫持者可永久锁定合法用户。

Network Devices.reason: Critically vulnerable NetScaler ADC and Gateway actively exploited in the wild, potentially compromising network perimeter security and enabling unauthorized access.
Network Devices.reason_en: Critically vulnerable NetScaler ADC and Gateway actively exploited in the wild, potentially compromising network perimeter security and enabling unauthorized access.
Network Devices.reason_zh: NetScaler ADC和Gateway存在高危漏洞且已在野外被活跃利用，可能破坏网络边界安全并导致未授权访问。

Web Security.reason: Missing authorization in UTMStack websocket handler allows any authenticated user to forward arbitrary commands, risking full system control.
Web Security.reason_en: Missing authorization in UTMStack websocket handler allows any authenticated user to forward arbitrary commands, risking full system control.
Web Security.reason_zh: UTMStack的WebSocket处理器存在授权缺失漏洞，允许任何已认证用户转发任意命令，可能导致系统控制权被完全夺取。

Web Security.reason: UTMStack authentication bypass grants full administrative API access using a valid internal key header, compromising security analytics infrastructure.
Web Security.reason_en: UTMStack authentication bypass grants full administrative API access using a valid internal key header, compromising security analytics infrastructure.
Web Security.reason_zh: UTMStack存在身份验证绕过漏洞，攻击者仅需提供有效的内部密钥头即可获取完整的管理员API访问权限，从而危及安全分析基础设施。

Web Security.reason: Blind SQL injection in Unlimited Elements WordPress plugin allows attackers to extract database information through unsanitized widget inputs.
Web Security.reason_en: Blind SQL injection in Unlimited Elements WordPress plugin allows attackers to extract database information through unsanitized widget inputs.
Web Security.reason_zh: WordPress插件Unlimited Elements存在盲SQL注入漏洞，攻击者可通过未过滤的小部件输入提取数据库信息。

Web Security.reason: AVideo stored XSS allows authenticated uploaders to inject malicious scripts via doubly-encoded video titles, affecting end-user browsers.
Web Security.reason_en: AVideo stored XSS allows authenticated uploaders to inject malicious scripts via doubly-encoded video titles, affecting end-user browsers.
Web Security.reason_zh: AVideo存在存储型XSS漏洞，已认证上传者可利用双重编码的视频标题注入恶意脚本，影响终端用户浏览器。

Web Security.reason: AVideo stored XSS via malicious video trailer URLs breaks out of onclick handlers, enabling persistent script execution in channel playlists.
Web Security.reason_en: AVideo stored XSS via malicious video trailer URLs breaks out of onclick handlers, enabling persistent script execution in channel playlists.
Web Security.reason_zh: AVideo通过恶意视频预告片URL存在存储型XSS漏洞，可突破onclick事件处理程序，实现在频道播放列表中持久化执行脚本。

Web Security.reason: SQL injection in UTMStack asset group search permits authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary SQL queries against the backend PostgreSQL database.
Web Security.reason_en: SQL injection in UTMStack asset group search permits authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary SQL queries against the backend PostgreSQL database.
Web Security.reason_zh: UTMStack的资产组搜索功能存在SQL注入漏洞，允许已认证攻击者对后端PostgreSQL数据库执行任意SQL查询。

Web Security.reason: Laravel Google Maps package disables TLS verification by default, facilitating on-path interception and manipulation of web service requests.
Web Security.reason_en: Laravel Google Maps package disables TLS verification by default, facilitating on-path interception and manipulation of web service requests.
Web Security.reason_zh: Laravel Google Maps软件包默认禁用TLS验证，便于对Web服务请求进行路径中间拦截和篡改。

Web Security.reason: RubyGem gist improperly validates certificates, allowing MITM attackers to steal OAuth tokens and modify GitHub API traffic.
Web Security.reason_en: RubyGem gist improperly validates certificates, allowing MITM attackers to steal OAuth tokens and modify GitHub API traffic.
Web Security.reason_zh: RubyGem gist组件证书验证机制存在缺陷，允许MITM攻击者窃取OAuth令牌并篡改GitHub API流量。

Web Security.reason: SQL injection in kishor-23 food-waste-management-system allows remote attackers to extract or manipulate database contents via unsanitized location arguments.
Web Security.reason_en: SQL injection in kishor-23 food-waste-management-system allows remote attackers to extract or manipulate database contents via unsanitized location arguments.
Web Security.reason_zh: kishor-23 food-waste-management-system存在SQL注入漏洞，远程攻击者可通过未过滤的位置参数提取或篡改数据库内容。

Web Security.reason: Publicly exploited SQL injection in mooSocial allows remote attackers to compromise database integrity via rating parameter manipulation.
Web Security.reason_en: Publicly exploited SQL injection in mooSocial allows remote attackers to compromise database integrity via rating parameter manipulation.
Web Security.reason_zh: mooSocial存在已被公开利用的SQL注入漏洞，远程攻击者可通过篡改评分参数破坏数据库完整性。

Other.reason: Code injection in InternLM MindSearch planner agent enables remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands within AI workflow executions.
Other.reason_en: Code injection in InternLM MindSearch planner agent enables remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands within AI workflow executions.
Other.reason_zh: InternLM MindSearch规划代理存在代码注入漏洞，允许远程攻击者在AI工作流执行过程中运行任意命令。

summary: Web security dominates the daily threat landscape with numerous authentication bypasses and SQL injection flaws targeting UTMStack, complemented by stored cross-site scripting vulnerabilities in AVideo. Cloud infrastructure faces significant exposure through critical account takeover risks in ZITADEL, while insecure default TLS configurations in go-micro and Laravel packages facilitate man-in-the-middle attacks across microservices and web requests. Network perimeter security is jeopardized by an actively exploited flaw in NetScaler, and broader operational risks include command injection vulnerabilities in AhsayCBS and the InternLM AI agent.
summary_en: Web security dominates the daily threat landscape with numerous authentication bypasses and SQL injection flaws targeting UTMStack, complemented by stored cross-site scripting vulnerabilities in AVideo. Cloud infrastructure faces significant exposure through critical account takeover risks in ZITADEL, while insecure default TLS configurations in go-micro and Laravel packages facilitate man-in-the-middle attacks across microservices and web requests. Network perimeter security is jeopardized by an actively exploited flaw in NetScaler, and broader operational risks include command injection vulnerabilities in AhsayCBS and the InternLM AI agent.
summary_zh: Web安全占据每日威胁态势的主导地位，针对UTMStack的身份验证绕过与SQL注入缺陷频发，AVideo的存储型跨站脚本漏洞与之形成补充。云基础设施因ZITADEL中严重的账户接管风险而面临重大暴露，go-micro与Laravel软件包中不安全的默认TLS配置则助长了微服务及Web请求间的中间人攻击。网络边界安全因NetScaler中被活跃利用的缺陷而受到威胁，更广泛的运营风险还涵盖AhsayCBS的命令注入漏洞及InternLM AI代理的安全隐患。
